hero.title: Our 35-Hectare Organic Cashew Farm in Odienné, Ivory Coast
hero.subtitle: Family-owned. Sustainably farmed. Cultivating West Africa's finest cashews through regenerative agriculture and organic practices.

overview.heading: 35 Hectares of Premium Cashew Production
overview.description: Nestled in Odienné, the epicenter of Ivory Coast's cashew production, our family-owned plantation is being developed using climate-smart agricultural techniques to yield premium grade raw cashew nuts with full traceability from soil to shipment.

map.description: Explore our 35-hectare family-owned cashew farm in the heart of Ivory Coast's cashew belt. The property spans 70 total hectares, with 35 currently under cultivation and the remainder reserved for future processing facilities and community development.
